name: logpacker
description: Analyse Qlik Replicate task logs with your company's LogPacker server.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a LogPacker server on the company network. Log files stay on this computer until you ask Claude to analyse one; the upload_log tool then streams it to the LogPacker server, which sanitises and analyses it.

server_url.title: LogPacker server URL
server_url.description: Root URL of the LogPacker server, e.g. http://logpacker.corp:8765

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The lp_... key from the LogPacker MCP page
